plugin.name: UI_Theme_Controller
plugin.author: ChatGPT
plugin.description:
SQUARESOFT UI THEME CONTROLLER v2.2
Public themes: theme default - GREEN TERMINAL palette (the old "green") theme classic - ORIGINAL gray/gold palette (the old "default") theme amber - amber terminal palette
There is no separate public "green" theme anymore: its palette IS "default". The former "default" palette has been moved to "classic". theme status
For backward compatibility, "theme green" is accepted as a deprecated synonym for "theme default".
On first upgrade with the same plugin ID, saved names are migrated: old green -> default old default -> classic

VALID_THEMES = { default = true, classic = true, amber = true }
function NormalizeThemeName(name) name = tostring(name or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if name == "green" then return "default" end if VALID_THEMES[name] then return name end return nil end
function MigrateSavedThemeName() -- v2.2 is the corrective rename pass: -- old green -> new default -- old default -> new classic -- -- If v2.1 was installed incompletely (for example themed clients were -- updated but the old controller remained), force the intended GREEN -- palette as the current default once so the suite cannot remain stuck on -- the old gray/gold palette while reporting "default". if GetVariable("theme_name_correction_v22") ~= "1" then SetVariable("theme", "default") SetVariable("effective_theme", "default") SetVariable("theme_name_migration_v21", "1") SetVariable("theme_name_correction_v22", "1") return "default" end
local existing = NormalizeThemeName(GetVariable("theme")) if not existing then existing = "default" end SetVariable("theme", existing) SetVariable("effective_theme", existing) return existing end
function CurrentTheme() local theme = NormalizeThemeName(GetVariable("theme")) if not theme then theme = "default" end return theme end
function BroadcastTheme() local theme = CurrentTheme() SetVariable("theme", theme) SetVariable("effective_theme", theme) BroadcastPlugin(THEME_BROADCAST_MESSAGE, theme) end
function SetTheme(name) local requested = tostring(name or ""):lower() local theme = NormalizeThemeName(requested) if not theme then return false end
SetVariable("theme", theme) SetVariable("effective_theme", theme) SetVariable("theme_name_migration_v21", "1") BroadcastTheme()
if requested == "green" then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Theme] 'green' is now named 'default'.") end ColourNote("lime", "", "[Theme] " .. theme) return true end
function GetThemeColour(profile, role) profile = tostring(profile or ""):lower() role = tostring(role or "") local p = PALETTES[profile] if not p then return "" end local t = p[CurrentTheme()] if not t then return "" end return tostring(t[role] or "") end
function GetThemeName() return CurrentTheme() end
function ThemeCommand(name, line, wildcards) local arg = tostring((wildcards and wildcards[1]) or ""):lower() if arg == "" or arg == "status" then ColourNote("cyan", "", "[Theme] current=" .. CurrentTheme() .. " available: default, classic, amber") return end if not SetTheme(arg) then ColourNote("red", "", "[Theme] Unknown theme. Use default, classic, or amber.") end end
function OnPluginInstall() MigrateSavedThemeName() BroadcastTheme() end
function OnPluginEnable() MigrateSavedThemeName() BroadcastTheme() end
function OnPluginSaveState() local theme = CurrentTheme() SetVariable("theme", theme) SetVariable("effective_theme", theme) end
